passes: engine ✓ · domain n/a — generic repo · lenses ✓

fix: Allow zero `--phase` arguments when `--predates` is nonempty, and test the all-started case.
text: `init` requires a `--phase`, but `/plan` §5.6.2a directs it to create a table with only `--predates` when every phase has started. That self-heal path always exits with a usage error.

fix: Define and implement a verification path for commitless phases that does not require an invented commit range.
text: Commitless phases retain a Verify task and receive a judge row, but `judge.py prepare` requires a nonempty commit range for every row’s repo. `/verify` therefore stops before judging these phases.

fix: Make the gate require review records covering each declared code repo and revision range before accepting Done.
text: The new workflow promises review before Done, but `verdict-gate.py` checks dispositions only if a review log exists. A code phase with passing finish rows and no `/review` run can be marked Done.

fix: Return structured block reasons with each unit, then use those reasons for the retry decision.
text: The requested `--all --json` output puts only check IDs in each unit’s `blocks`. It never puts `no final verdict` or `an unfinished run` there, so the prescribed test cannot identify units that need `/verify` before archive.

fix: Deduplicate index paths and count only scopes with at least one gated unit whose `--all` verdict passes.
text: `gate-count` treats an archived scope as clean solely because its index rows lack ⚠. It does not check a passing verdict or even require a gated row, so an all-predating or unverified table can advance the five-scope blocking threshold. Passing an index explicitly alongside `--discover` can count it twice.

fix: Require readable raw judge output for a run judged by a model; return an evaluation error when it is missing.
text: If a finalized judged run’s raw judge JSON is missing, `collect` silently uses `{}` and drops every judge-named lever candidate, while closeout can report that there are none.

fix: Reject lever candidates whose `check_id` is absent from `check_ids`.
text: Judge-produced lever candidates are checked for `lever_id` shape, but their `check_id` is not checked against this run’s checks. An invented ID can enter the TO-DO ledger with `Touches: ?` and be counted as a later sighting.

fix: Track the time of a successful `origin main` fetch specifically, or fetch that ref on every check.
text: `FETCH_HEAD` can be refreshed by a fetch of another branch. The script then skips fetching `main` and can print nothing while `origin/main` is stale, contrary to its freshness claim.

fix: Change the threshold here to five.
text: This live skill instruction still says the advisory gate lasts until three clean scopes; the configured threshold and the other updated instructions say five.
